q: How long does a small company take to prepare its first carbon footprint?
title: Time for a first carbon footprint
short: It depends mostly on how easy your records are to find. If twelve months of electricity bills and fuel invoices are in one place, Scope 1 and 2 can be done quickly. Scope 3 takes longer because supplier data has to be collected and checked. Gathering documents is usually the slowest step.

ol: Collect twelve months of electricity bills and fuel invoices for each site.
Calculate Scope 1 and 2 and check unit conversions.
List purchases by spend and pick the largest for Scope 3.
Write a short method note and an estimates log.

ul: Discom portal logins for every meter.
Suppliers who send e-invoices with quantities.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.
